scope: Exact frozen four-prefix/six-arm/two-seed engineering replay with one active vLLM sequence, eager execution and original non-batch-invariant MARLIN backend. Invalid semantic starts are not used for efficacy.
interpretation: Stress throughput is a prospective planning assumption, not measured serial 256-token throughput. If a complete stage cannot fit or any engine/isolation check fails, stop and reprice before causal enrollment. A preemption test cannot fire with max_num_seqs=1 and requires a separate qualification for any later batched profile.
